As a result keys[] remained [] and could not be picked up. Recommend main agent verify no vertical route from cave y=1140 back to surface y=700 exists west of the shaft (should not be possible without ladder w-press).

rca of the issue: Not conclusive. Two independent observations from repeated runs: (1) After descending to cave floor y=1140 at x=1836 and holding ArrowLeft (with periodic jumps to clear pillars/spikes), the player's y transitioned back to 700 (surface) before reaching the pedestal at x=700. This suggests either the pillar at x=1200-1270 has a top that connects to surface, or a one-way platform above cave lets the player pop up. (2) On the plateau, right traversal stalls at x=2892 (~1000px short of the portal). Neither issue was reproduced far enough to isolate root cause; recommend E1 add a geometry dump or run a controlled probe.
